A cast, throw, shot; कुरुष्व तावत् करभोरु पश्चान्मार्गे मृगप्रेक्षिणि दृष्टिपातम्
An epithet of Rāhu; दक्षिणोत्तरतो$प्येवं पातु राहुः स्वरंहसा । विक्षिपत्येष विक्षेपं चन्द्रादीनामपक्रमात् ॥ Sūrya S.
(In astr.) An inauspicious or malignant position or aspect.
The node in a planet's orbit.

पातञ्जल [pātañjala], a. (-ली f.) Composed by Patañjali; पातञ्जले महाभाष्ये कृतभूरिपरिश्रमः Paribhāṣenduśekhara. -लम् The Yoga system of philosophy taught by Patañjali. (It is generally believed that Patañjali, the author of the Mahābhāṣya, is the same as the author of the Yoga system; but it is a dubious point.)
पातन [pātana], a. [पत्-णिच् ल्यु ल्युट् वा] Felling, cutting down.
नम् Causing to fall down, bringing or throwing down, knocking down.

N. of a particular process to which minerals (esp. quicksilver) are subjected. N. B. पातनम् may have different meanings according to the noun with which it is used; e. g. दण़्डस्य पातनम् 'causing the rod to fall', i. e. chastising; गर्भस्य पातनम्' causing the fœtus to fall', causing an abortion.
The last of the seven regions or worlds under the earth said to be peopled by Nāgas. the seven regions are: अतल, वितल, सुतल, रसातल, तलातल, महातल and पाताल.
The lower regions or world in general; मा मेति व्याहरत्येव तस्मिन् पातालमभ्यगात्
;1.8; पातालान्न विमोचितो बत बली नीतो न मृत्युः क्षयम् Subhāṣ.
(In astrol.) The fourth house or sign from that in which the sun is present.
लः A kind of instrument for distillation or the calcination and sublimation of metals.
N. of Jupiter's year (of 361 days). -Comp. -गङ्गा the Ganges of the lower world. -ओकस् m., -निलयः, -निवासः, -वासिन् m.
a Nāga or a serpent-demon. -तलम्, -मूलम् the bottom of Pātāla. -मुखम् a great hollow (महागर्त); यत्त्वद्य पातालमुखे पतन्तं पाणौ गृहीत्वा प्रतिसंहरेत
. -मूलम् the centre or gravity; आस्ते पातालमूलस्थः शेषो$शेषसुतर्चितः V.
पातित्यम् [pātityam], Loss of caste or position; एतत् पातित्यदान्नो जघनमतिघनादेनसो माननीयम् Viṣṇupād Stotra, 21.
A woman of a particular class.
पातिव्रती [pātivratī] पातिव्रत्यम् [pātivratyam], पातिव्रत्यम् Fidelity to a husband, chastity; Śāhendra.1.61.
Falling habitually or frequently; संयच्छन् भवति प्राणानसंयच्छंस्तु पातुकः
कः The declivity of a mountain, a precipice.
पात्त्र [pāttra], a. Releasing from sins; सर्वेषामेव पात्त्राणां परं पात्त्रं महेश्वरः Nandī P.
To be caused to fall, to be felled or cut down.
To be imposed (as a fine); see पत्.
A vessel of iron, brass or silver.
पात्रयति [pātrayati], Den. P. To use as a drinking-vessel; पाणिं पात्रयताम्
पात्रसात् [pātrasāt], ind. In the possession of worthy persons.
To make worthy; पात्रीकृतो दस्युरिवासि येन Ś.5.2.
पात्रीण [pātrīṇa], a. Measured, sown, or cooked with a Pātra.
पात्रीय [pātrīya] पात्र्य [pātrya], पात्र्य a. Worthy to partake of a meal.
पात्रीयम् [pātrīyam], A sacrificial vessel or utensil.
